category.name: E-commerce
category.description: Manage stores, products, orders and marketplace listings.

entries.name: Amazon Selling Partner API
entries.auth_hint: LWA (Login with Amazon) OAuth2 access token via x-amz-access-token header
entries.free_tier: free API access; requires an existing Amazon Seller/Vendor Central account
entries.desc_en: Manage listings, orders, inventory, and reports for an Amazon seller/vendor account via REST API.
entries.notes: Self-authorized (private) apps for your own seller account are relatively quick to set up; public apps serving other sellers require Amazon's app-approval review.

entries.name: BigCommerce API
entries.auth_hint: X-Auth-Token header (store API account) or OAuth2 for public apps
entries.free_tier: free API access; requires an active BigCommerce store plan
entries.desc_en: Manage catalog, orders, customers, and carts on a BigCommerce store via REST/GraphQL APIs.
entries.notes: Official MCP server is for documentation search/dev assistance, not direct storefront execution - use API tokens for that.

entries.name: eBay APIs
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token> (application or user token)
entries.free_tier: free developer tier with call-volume limits; sandbox environment included
entries.desc_en: List items, manage orders/inventory, and search listings across eBay marketplaces via REST APIs.
entries.notes: Production access requires an eBay developer account and app keys; rate limits scale with account compliance tier.

entries.name: Etsy Open API v3
entries.auth_hint: OAuth2 Bearer token + x-api-key header (app keystring)
entries.free_tier: free developer keystring (rate-limited, e.g. 10 req/sec, ~5,000 req/day per app by default)
entries.desc_en: List products, manage orders/shop, and search listings on the Etsy marketplace via REST API.
entries.notes: Requires an approved Etsy developer app; OAuth2 user consent needed for shop-management scopes. Missing from candidate list despite being a major agent-callable marketplace API.

entries.name: Mercado Libre API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> obtained via OAuth 2.0 with the app's Client ID and Secret from DevCenter
entries.free_tier: Free API access for any Mercado Libre account that creates an app in DevCenter; only normal marketplace selling fees apply
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent search items and categories and manage a seller's listings, orders, questions, shipments and promotions on the Mercado Libre marketplace.
entries.notes: In AR, MX, BR and CL the account holder's details must be validated before creating an app; redirect URI must be HTTPS; rate limited (HTTP 429). Official MCP (OAuth, streamable HTTP) only searches and reads developer documentation.

entries.name: Printful API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <token> (Private token or OAuth2 for public apps)
entries.free_tier: free API access; pay only for products/fulfillment/shipping ordered
entries.desc_en: Create print-on-demand products, sync catalogs, and submit fulfillment orders via REST API.

entries.name: Shopify Admin / Storefront API
entries.auth_hint: X-Shopify-Access-Token header (custom app token or OAuth2 for public apps)
entries.free_tier: free API access; requires an active paid Shopify store subscription to use
entries.desc_en: Manage products, orders, customers, and inventory (Admin API) or build storefronts (Storefront API) via REST/GraphQL.
entries.notes: The official Dev MCP server helps build/debug Shopify apps via docs & schema search; store operations themselves go through Admin/Storefront API tokens.

entries.name: WooCommerce REST API
entries.auth_hint: OAuth1.0a signature (HTTP) or Basic auth with Consumer Key/Secret (HTTPS)
entries.free_tier: free (self-hosted plugin; no vendor API fees, only your own WordPress hosting costs)
entries.desc_en: Manage products, orders, and customers on a self-hosted WooCommerce store via REST API.
entries.notes: Requires your own WordPress+WooCommerce installation; there is no shared multi-tenant cloud endpoint.
